prior_summary: World Cartesian targets are conditioned on explicit causal phase geometry and motion: peg and lid-handle relations, fingers, peg height, co-motion proxy, lid state, and robot configuration.
applicable_conditions: Prefer as the broad early-to-late/default policy when uncertainty is chiefly whether the hand is still releasing the lid, clearing/open-approaching, closing near the peg, or carrying it. Observable geometry should remain within successful-demonstration support.
termination_guidance: Use combined evidence rather than a single phase cue: closed fingers, peg above the wall, and low recent change in peg-to-TCP relation while both move. Then hand off within the supervised outgoing lift overlap.
limitations: Phase cues are deterministic observations, not contact truth. World-absolute targets extrapolate poorly to large peg displacement and can be unreachable from changed qpos. Demonstrations contain no failed-grasp negatives or recovery behavior.
